en.assortment.continuity.title: Continuity
en.assortment.continuity.intro: Recover where you were, what is active now, what meaningfully changed, and where you want to resume.

en.assortment.timeline.event1.title: Continuity doorway became a working path
en.assortment.timeline.event1.summary: Continue reached Continuity, Resume reached Project depth, and Projects remained reachable.
en.assortment.timeline.event2.title: The reusable practicum kit entered accepted main
en.assortment.timeline.event2.summary: Human-first launch, passive readiness, VexWalk, and P0–P6 proof boundaries became source-managed.
en.assortment.timeline.event3.title: Continuity event grammar entered accepted main
en.assortment.timeline.event3.summary: Journey, Presentation observation, Intent Workgraph truth, Timeline, and Revisit were separated into their rightful roles.
en.assortment.timeline.event4.title: The assumed package lineage was rejected
en.assortment.timeline.event4.summary: The next preview must be rebuilt from accepted source and human-proven behavior rather than inheriting a contaminated package chain.
en.assortment.revisit.record1.summary: An existing durable trajectory with its own owner and planning continuity.
en.assortment.revisit.record2.summary: Captured as a multi-home idea; it remains intentionally distinct from admitted work.
en.assortment.revisit.record3.summary: Captured from a real resource-health need; implementation remains held until rightful owners are joined.
en.assortment.projects.title: Projects
en.assortment.projects.intro: Inspect admitted Project trajectories without silently changing what VexLife considers current.
en.assortment.frontier.title: Frontier
en.assortment.frontier.intro: Keep important ideas recoverable before they earn Project or Feature admission.
en.assortment.project-depth.intro: A source-backed Project view with a reusable Process Trail. Inspecting history does not move the current position.

en.assortment.process.moment1.summary: Selection stays distinct from current position; horizontal and vertical presentations share one history.
en.assortment.process.moment2.title: Projects separated breadth from depth
en.assortment.process.moment2.summary: Projects became the place to choose among admitted Projects while Continue remained the fast path into current depth.
en.assortment.process.moment3.title: Frontier protected ideas before admission
en.assortment.process.moment3.summary: Captured intent remained safe without silently becoming a Project or a second lifecycle owner.
en.assortment.process.moment4.title: Capture + Lineage accepted
en.assortment.process.moment4.summary: Source routes and existing-work recovery made the design continuity more trustworthy.
en.assortment.process.moment5.title: Continuity doorway proved

en.assortment.process.moment7.title: Human walk
en.assortment.process.moment7.summary: Victor experiences the verified candidate and decides what the design actually teaches next.

en.assortment.process.moment8.summary: Preserved as a later design edge; it does not jump the current Continuity sequence.

ja.assortment.continuity.title: 連続性

ja.assortment.timeline.event1.title: 連続性の入口が実際に動く経路になった
ja.assortment.timeline.event1.summary: Continue から Continuity、Resume から Project 深度へ到達し、Projects も引き続き到達可能でした。
ja.assortment.timeline.event2.title: 再利用可能な実習キットが accepted main に入った
ja.assortment.timeline.event2.summary: 人優先起動、受動準備確認、VexWalk、P0–P6 の証明境界がソース管理されました。
ja.assortment.timeline.event3.title: 連続性イベント文法が accepted main に入った
ja.assortment.timeline.event3.summary: Journey、Presentation 観測、Intent Workgraph の真実、Timeline、Revisit の役割が分離されました。
ja.assortment.timeline.event4.title: 仮定に基づくパッケージ系譜を棄却
ja.assortment.timeline.event4.summary: 次のプレビューは汚染されたパッケージ連鎖ではなく、accepted source と人が確認した挙動から再構成します。
ja.assortment.revisit.record1.summary: 独自の所有者と計画継続性を持つ既存の永続トラジェクトリです。
ja.assortment.revisit.record2.summary: 複数ホームのアイデアとして捕捉済みで、承認済み作業とは意図的に区別されています。
ja.assortment.revisit.record3.summary: 実際のリソース健全性ニーズから捕捉され、正しい所有者が結合されるまで実装は保留です。

ja.assortment.process.title: Process Trail
ja.assortment.process.moment1.title: Process Trail 基盤を受け入れ
ja.assortment.process.moment1.summary: 選択位置と現在位置を分離し、横・縦表示が同じ履歴を共有します。
ja.assortment.process.moment2.title: Projects が広がりと深度を分離
ja.assortment.process.moment2.summary: Projects は承認済み Project を選ぶ場所となり、Continue は現在の深度への高速経路を維持しました。
ja.assortment.process.moment3.title: Frontier が承認前のアイデアを保護
ja.assortment.process.moment3.summary: 捕捉した意図は Project や第二のライフサイクル所有者に自動変換されず安全に保持されます。
ja.assortment.process.moment4.title: Capture + Lineage を受け入れ
ja.assortment.process.moment4.summary: ソース経路と既存作業の回復により設計連続性の信頼性が高まりました。
ja.assortment.process.moment5.title: Continuity 入口を実証
ja.assortment.process.moment5.summary: Victor のウォークで Home → Continue → Continuity と Resume → Project 深度が動作しました。
ja.assortment.process.moment6.title: 戻る操作 + 連続性文法
ja.assortment.process.moment6.summary: 現在のソース上で入口を再構成し、限定 Back、複数の現在作業、意味ある Timeline、別の Revisit を追加します。
ja.assortment.process.moment7.title: 人によるウォーク
ja.assortment.process.moment7.summary: Victor が検証済み候補を体験し、次に何を学んだかを決めます。
ja.assortment.process.moment8.title: System / Resource Health
ja.assortment.process.moment8.summary: 後続の設計エッジとして保存され、現在の Continuity 順序を飛び越えません。
